cards.claim: Marion Jessie Thompson's spouse is Dows Dunham.
cards.quote: In a remarkable discovery, our investigative team has uncovered conclusive evidence that Marion Jessie Thompson, a woman of mystery born in 1890, was indeed married to renowned American archaeologist Dows Dunham. While Thompson's life has remained largely shrouded in secrecy, our research has shed new light on her personal life, revealing a fascinating connection to one of the most prominent archaeologists of the 20th century. According to marriage records obtained from the New York State Archives, Marion Jessie Thompson and Dows Dunham tied the knot on June 24, 1922, in Albany, New York. The certificate, dated June 26, 1922, confirms the union, providing irrefutable proof of their marriage.
